x-state-semantics.ACCEPTED: Original bytes durably fenced; one broadcast acknowledgment, no committed execution proof.
x-state-semantics.UNKNOWN: Signing/broadcast/result uncertainty; maintain reservation and global signer fence, never rebroadcast.
x-state-semantics.OBSERVED_NONCREDITING: Observed evidence lacks independent authentication; maintain hold.
x-state-semantics.CONFIRMED: Exact original bytes and successful committed bank effect authenticated against independent operator checkpoint; consumer still owns ledger consumption.
x-state-semantics.FAILED: Authenticated terminal original transaction failure only; never implies permission to replay same obligation.
x-state-semantics.REFUSED: No authorization for this request; durable identity and any earlier uncertainty remain authoritative.

PrivateBearer.description: Exactly one Authorization header; Bearer plus private 48–512 character base64url token. Literal loopback only and no Origin header. Token is not owner consent, custody attestation or withdrawal approval.

CustodyJournal.description: One consistent bounded local execution-journal checkpoint (8MiB/100000 framed records/max64 bucket depth). Digest includes exact stored bucket/key/value bytes and current policy identity. Held outbound includes UNKNOWN/ACCEPTED/OBSERVED_NONCREDITING operations; confirmed totals are journal history, not independently reauthenticated bank balance. Does not describe the app customer ledger, fees, outside liabilities, deposits or available reserves; no subtraction of these totals establishes solvency. Corrupt, over-limit, conflicting or unsupported history refuses the entire checkpoint.

WagerReservation.description: New wagering authority v1, independently Ed25519-signed with exported WagerReservationMessage. Approval binds exact durable app reservation, owner consent, ledger revision, vault, recipient, amount, memo, operating fee and <=300 second window. Source token alone cannot authorize a new wager. Digests do not prove actual ledger balances or solvency.

WagerCamel.description: Compatibility spelling selected only by protocol:1. Never mix camel-case and snake-case fields. ownerId is required for portable owner-bound proofs; absence cannot prove an owner.

WithdrawalApproval.description: Both ADR-36 owner consent and independent Ed25519 approval are mandatory. Use Go ApprovalMessage, OwnerMandateDigest and WithdrawalHoldDigest; do not invent a JSON canonicalizer. Approval expires after at most 300 seconds and binds the durable app hold.

FinancialProof.description: Untrusted transcript, never credit authority. Independently run the exact-source offline verifier against independently provisioned trust and app durable expected context. Receipt ID is wolo-1:UPPERCASE_TX_HASH:transfer_index; physical global consumption must bind chain_id+tx_hash+message_index(0), not the unauthenticated event ordinal. Envelope assertions and agreement between RPC endpoints do not establish trust.

ReturnApproval.description: Version 2 only. An exact signed immutable entitlement owns one claim. Claim 889 is forbidden. Partial matched payouts and full unmatched principal refunds obey signed allocation and shared funds-budget conservation; bearer authentication alone grants no entitlement.

Health.description: Private runtime assertion. AVAILABLE requires opaque native bank-proof/dual-review/journal/runtime qualification and expires or revokes; it does not independently discover accounting completeness, authorize app credits, clear historical HOLD or prove production custody from source fixtures. Current source C2 capability remains UNAVAILABLE. Missing qualification stays UNAVAILABLE.

OperationResult.description: Historical kind:broadcast_confirmed acknowledges at most an accepted one-shot broadcast. Only status:CONFIRMED after authenticated exact-byte chain reconciliation is committed execution. ACCEPTED/UNKNOWN/transport failure never authorize retry or release of liability. A repeated same operation never broadcasts again; changed payload conflicts.

ReservedOperationResult.description: Protocol-2 result uses actual status. kind:unknown with status:ACCEPTED is only a one-shot acknowledgment, never committed payment. No historical broadcast_confirmed alias is emitted.

BankStateProof.description: UNTRUSTED portable RPC evidence for the server-selected protected vault or escrow role at head-1. Consumers must authenticate exact account and Comet/ICS23 H/H+1 proof against protected authority. No credit, spending or solvency authority.

ReviewerCustodyFeeCheckpoint.description: Read-only actual journal fee snapshot. Requested IDs restrict status lookup only, never unresolved fees. Fingerprints require authenticated original approval identity; empty identity cannot discharge an issuer obligation. No bank, credit or spending authority.

PrincipalCheckpoint.description: Complete globally sorted terminal custody history, not an app-selected operation subset. Existing UNKNOWN/ACCEPTED effects refuse this checkpoint. Protected peer/vault/policy enrollment supplies service provenance; JSON does not establish independent Comet confirmation, operator independence or spending authority. The actual PG owner partition and independently signed reserve inventory remain required.

x-event-identity.receipt_display: wolo-1:UPPERCASE_TX_HASH:transfer_index; transfer event index is not independent consensus authority

x-client-recovery.on_timeout_or_disconnection: Retain app reservation. Query original operation then reconcile exact original signed transaction. Never change identity or rebroadcast.
x-client-recovery.on_unknown: Preserve durable reservation, signer sequence fence and all latest history; operator proof may reconcile outcome but cannot invent success or nonpayment.
x-client-recovery.on_proof_unavailable: Keep NONCREDITING. Independently pin trust and reverify against own durable expected context; never use raw HTTP JSON as ledger authority.
x-client-recovery.on_historical_collision: Refuse new financial work; preserve all original obligations and investigate privately without retries.
